reason: The sachet idea fits my life since I forget pills at home, but $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I can get a bottle that lasts longer. I would not pay that for magnesium when I am not sure it will do anything for me.
objection: $29.99 for 30 days is more than the brands I already know, and I am paying extra for packaging when a bottle in my bag costs less.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $19 to $20 a box, or a cheap trial box so I can see if it helps me sleep before paying full price.
